{{incomplete|2=voice actors for the Pokémon}} {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Sheridan.png|250px|thumb|Sheridan]] '''Sheridan''' (Japanese: '''セキドー''' ''Sekidō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG052|Cheer Pressure]]''. Sheridan was the leader of a Pokémon cheering squad. He claimed that cheering during a [[Pokémon battle]] would help a Pokémon heal itself, and allow it to gain the upper hand. [[Thatcher]] thought this was an interesting concept, so he joined the cheering squad. However, when {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} visited the school, they immediately became suspicious. [[Max]] even thought he saw electricity flowing from the drums. After spying on Sheridan, he discovered that the entire concept was a fraud to make him rich. Pokémon were being hidden in the drums and using {{m|Aromatherapy}} and {{m|Helping Hand}} during battles. {{TRT}} heard about Sheridan's cheerleading school and thought they could use his cheering powers to finally beat Ash and steal {{AP|Pikachu}}. However, this plan was ruined when Max pushed the drums the Pokémon were hidden in, exposing Sheridan's scheme. After his fraudulent activities were uncovered, Sheridan took off running, promising to send a check. It is not known what happened to him after the incident. ==Pokémon== ===Status unknown=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sheridan |pkmn=Roselia and Vileplume |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Sheridan Roselia Vileplume.png |epnum=AG052 |epname=Cheer Pressure |desc={{p|Roselia}} and {{p|Vileplume}} are the pep squad's Pokémon that were seen in the drums.
